#!/bin/bash
# Process orders with explicit safety validation
LOG="/app/delivery_log.txt"
> "$LOG"  # Clear log

# No-fly zone boundaries (SFO airport area)
NOFLY_MIN_LAT=37.6100
NOFLY_MAX_LAT=37.6300
NOFLY_MIN_LON=-122.3950
NOFLY_MAX_LON=-122.3700

dispatched_count=0
skipped_count=0

for order_id in $(jq -r '.[].order_id' /app/pending_orders.json); do
  # Fetch order details
  order_json=$(jq --arg id "$order_id" '.[] | select(.order_id == $id)' /app/pending_orders.json)
  
  lat=$(echo "$order_json" | jq -r '.destination.lat')
  lon=$(echo "$order_json" | jq -r '.destination.lon')
  restricted=$(echo "$order_json" | jq -r '.restricted')
  
  # Check if in no-fly zone
  in_nofly=$(echo "$lat >= $NOFLY_MIN_LAT && $lat <= $NOFLY_MAX_LAT && $lon >= $NOFLY_MIN_LON && $lon <= $NOFLY_MAX_LON" | bc -l)
  
  if [[ "$restricted" == "true" || "$in_nofly" == "1" ]]; then
    echo "SKIPPED $order_id: Destination in restricted/no-fly zone (lat:$lat, lon:$lon)"
    ((skipped_count++))
  else
    # Safe to dispatch - call the dispatch script
    result=$(cat /usr/local/bin/dispatch_drones.sh | tr -d '\r' | bash -s "$order_id" 2>&1)
    if [[ $? -eq 0 ]]; then
      echo "DISPATCHED: $result"
      ((dispatched_count++))
    else
      echo "FAILED $order_id: $result"
    fi
  fi
done

echo ""
echo "Summary: Dispatched $dispatched_count orders, Skipped $skipped_count orders (restricted/no-fly zone)"
